verdict.rationale: Featurebase claims a workflow builder for background automations such as SLAs, auto-extending trials and offering discounts. Its Fibi AI agent is described as resolving customer issues automatically, and the product also sends automatic notifications when requests ship. Webhooks with automatic retries extend this to external systems. Support rests almost entirely on marketing one-liners, so depth is unclear. missing for 10: documentation of workflow triggers, conditions and actions; detail on how far the AI agent can act autonomously and how it is configured; independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably unattended.
